title: 多级上下文融合提升混合专家模型路由一致性
summary: 提出MCF-MOE框架，通过跨层语义聚合和局部token交互构建上下文感知表示，解决MoE路由中上下文不完整导致的专家选择不一致问题，在语言建模和理解基准上优于强基线。
summary_en: Proposes MCF-MOE, a framework that constructs context-aware representations via cross-layer semantic aggregation and local token interactions, addressing context incompleteness in MoE routing for more consistent expert selection, outperforming strong baselines on language modeling and understanding benchmarks.
